en.title: Unpaid Salaries — Running Payroll
en.summary: The payroll sheet for one month. Check it, choose the bank, attach the receipt, run it.

sections.heading: Before you press run
sections.body:
1. The month's attendance is entered.
2. Every new hire has been approved — a pending employee cannot be paid.
3. Overtime, bonuses and deductions dated in the month are recorded (Finance → Overtime / Bonuses / Deductions).
4. Anything dated in a month already paid is refused there, so record it in an unpaid month.
5. The month's procedures are marked completed on the patients' charts — a clinician's commission is worked out from them.

Anything added after the run is not in it. The order is what makes the month reconcile.

sections.heading: Running it
sections.body:
1. Narrow the list with the column filters — department, position, branch, employment — and read the figures at the top: gross, tax, pension and net, for everyone or for those ticked.
2. Tick who is being paid and press Pay.
3. Choose the account the money leaves from, set the payment date and attach the transfer receipt — this is what reconciles the payroll to the bank statement later.
4. Pay.

The figures on screen are a preview: each payslip is worked out again as it is paid, so nothing changed in the browser can alter an amount. The run, every payslip and the bank transaction are written together; if anything fails, nothing is written.

'What the bank needs' switches the table to name, bank, account and net, for printing the transfer list.

sections.heading: Commission
sections.body: An employee whose salary has Commission set to Yes earns its percentage of the fees of every procedure they completed in the month, at the rate on their salary on the day of the work. It is added to gross pay and taxed like the rest of it. Work still planned, or completed in another month, does not count.

sections.heading: If it refuses or looks short
sections.body:
• Unapproved employees are refused and the message names how many. Approve them in the Employees queue, then run again for the remainder.
• A total that looks light is usually a missing overtime or deduction entry, or an employee still pending.
• Somebody paid since the page was opened is refused rather than paid twice — reload, and they are gone from the list.
• Once the run exists it waits in the Payroll Runs approval queue before it counts.

am.title: ያልተከፈሉ ደመወዞች — ደመወዝ ማስኬድ
am.summary: የአንድ ወር የደመወዝ ሉህ። ያረጋግጡ፣ ባንክ ይምረጡ፣ ደረሰኝ ያያይዙ፣ ያስኪዱ።

sections.heading: ከማስኬድዎ በፊት
sections.body:
1. የወሩ የመገኘት መዝገብ ገብቷል።
2. አዲስ ተቀጣሪዎች ሁሉ ጸድቀዋል — ያልጸደቀ ሠራተኛ ክፍያ አይፈጸምለትም።
3. የወሩ ትርፍ ሰዓት ገብቷል።
4. የወሩ ተቀናሾች ገብተዋል።
5. የወሩ ሕክምናዎች በታካሚዎቹ ቻርት ላይ እንደተጠናቀቁ ተመዝግበዋል — የባለሙያው ኮሚሽን የሚሰላው ከእነሱ ነው።

ከክፍያው በኋላ የተጨመረ ማንኛውም ነገር አልተካተተም። ወሩ እንዲመሳከር የሚያደርገው ይህ ቅደም ተከተል ነው።

sections.heading: ማስኬድ
sections.body:
1. ዝርዝሩን በዓምዶቹ ማጣሪያዎች ያጥብቡ፤ ከላይ ያሉትን አሃዞች ያንብቡ።
2. የሚከፈላቸውን ምልክት አድርገው ክፈል ይጫኑ።
3. ገንዘቡ የሚወጣበትን ሂሳብ፣ የክፍያ ቀንና የዝውውር ደረሰኙን ያስገቡ።
4. ይክፈሉ።

በማያ ገጹ ላይ ያሉት አሃዞች ቅድመ እይታ ናቸው፦ እያንዳንዱ የደመወዝ ወረቀት ሲከፈል እንደገና ይሰላል።

sections.heading: ኮሚሽን
sections.body: ደመወዙ ላይ ኮሚሽን "Yes" የተደረገለት ሠራተኛ በወሩ ውስጥ ካጠናቀቃቸው ሕክምናዎች ክፍያ ላይ የተቀመጠውን መቶኛ ያገኛል፤ መጠኑ ሥራው በተሠራበት ቀን በደመወዙ ላይ የነበረው ነው። ከጠቅላላ ክፍያ ጋር ተደምሮ እንደ ቀሪው ይታክሳል። ገና የታቀደ ወይም በሌላ ወር የተጠናቀቀ ሥራ አይቆጠርም።

sections.heading: ካልተቀበለ ወይም ያነሰ ከመሰለ
sections.body:
• ያልጸደቁ ሠራተኞች አይካተቱም፤ መልእክቱም ስንት እንደሆኑ ይነግርዎታል። በሠራተኞች ወረፋ ውስጥ አጽድቀው ለቀሪው እንደገና ያስኪዱ።
• ያነሰ የመሰለ ድምር አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ያልገባ ትርፍ ሰዓት ወይም ተቀናሽ፣ ወይም ገና ያልጸደቀ ሠራተኛ ነው።
• ክፍያው ከተፈጠረ በኋላ ከመቆጠሩ በፊት በደመወዝ ማጽደቅ ወረፋ ውስጥ ይጠብቃል።
